name: Unidentified HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class freighter
description: An HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter was owned by a Quarren male during the Clone Wars. The freighter was stolen by Cad Bane, Moralo Eval, and Obi-Wan Kenobi—disguised as Rako Hardeen—during their escape from Coruscant's Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center.
